I had some code like this in BASIC for my 3ds but it was for an FPS counter.

PRINT “ Frames drawn since start :“ ;MAINCNT

PRINT “Minutes since start :” ;MILLISEC/1000/60

FRAMES%= MILLISEC/1000

FPS%= MAINCNT/FRAMES%

PRINT “Frames Per Second :” ;FPS%

the 3ds has some backend shit that starts counting milliseconds since startup and frames since startup, and with 5th grade math, you can make a framerate counter.

Maybe the SPT server has some backend clock that ReShade could pull from?
